race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: The form of LA VALSERINE 's French bumper worked out extremely well and, having joined the all-conquering Mullins yard, she's taken to land what looks a warm mares maiden on hurdling debut. Moonverrin reached a useful level in bumpers and looks the pick of the potential dangers, though several others, including Royale Walk demand respect. LA VALSERINE (FR) MOONVERRIN (IRE) ROYALE WALK (IRE)
